name: Default
shortDescription: Music and video automation server that syncs playlists, watches artists and downloads from Soulseek, streaming services, torrent or usenet into an organized library.

alerts.message: The web UI has no login until you set an admin PIN or username and password under Settings > System > Security. Turn on "Behind a reverse proxy" there too and restart the app.

Spotify sign-in needs your own developer app credentials, with the redirect URI set to https://<your-domain>/callback in both Spotify and SoulSync. Soulseek needs a separate slskd instance and its API key.
